source_state: uncommitted working tree; includes AAC encoder, opt-in observation and synthetic platform tests; exact Android hashes in source-files.sha256.json
scope: Experimental debug V3 AAC-LC ADTS codec102 mono16kHz talkback encoder, existing PCM100 retained

supported_formats.adts: MPEG-4, no CRC, one raw-data block

implementation.encoder: Android MediaCodec; no vendor code or new dependencies
implementation.stop: Discard pending speech, no flush to camera; release encoder in attempt finally
implementation.start: Permission/foreground checks and correlated CBC ACK still precede microphone capture
implementation.transport_failure: IOException propagates through encoder callback to existing shared-socket recovery

android_synthetic.scope: Synthetic tone -> actual MediaCodec encoder -> ADTS -> encrypted V3 envelope -> actual MediaCodec decoder; closed-state and transport failure checks. No microphone, AudioTrack or camera.

camera_metadata.scope: Explicitly authorized saved-profile LAN metadata read using production stream reader, no rendering/decoder or outgoing audio

native_finding: DEX constant102 is ADTS AAC. Input audio22 takes the encoded payload copy branch. Factory2001 is ADPCM and2002 is AAC; the PCM21 fallback is not used as an AAC encoder.
limitations: The camera now passes the format gate, but live microphone, camera start ACK and physical speaker output require user acceptance.
Platform encoder/decoder tested on Android API33 only; no API26/OEM-wide runtime claim.
App PCM buffers are bounded to192ms; AudioRecord/MediaCodec native buffers are additional. No physical end-to-end latency claim.
AAC8kHz, stereo, HE-AAC, ADPCM, Legacy and incoming camera audio remain unavailable.
